name: Aurelia
loreTies: Source: Choirs/bells/edicts (sung law, resonance, sacred bureaucracy)
shortBackstory: Aurelia is the radiant-spear controller — the Choir-source who controls through sung law. Her voice does not command; it resonates, and the resonance shapes reality.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Aurelia was born from the choir — the harmonious voices that sing creation into order. She is the controller who shapes the battlefield through sung law. Ancient humans heard the angelic choirs — but they heard the music and missed the legislation. Aurelia's song is law set to frequency.

chapters.title: Faction Bond
chapters.text: Among the Empyrean, Aurelia makes the faction's order audible. Her choir-sung law creates zones of harmonic control. She works with Seraphel — he defines the order, and she sings it into reality.

chapters.title: Gate Wound
chapters.text: The Mythos Gate wounded Aurelia by making her song inaudible. The Hollow created a silence that swallowed her frequency. A song that is not heard is not law; it is just vibration.

chapters.title: Campaign Role
chapters.text: In the Empyrean Choir Vault, Aurelia shapes the battlefield through sung law. Her radiant-spear staff projects harmonic frequencies. But the Hollow creates zones of absolute silence where her song cannot resonate.

chapters.title: Personal Conflict
chapters.text: Aurelia's flaw is that she has never tolerated dissonance. She has silenced voices that did not conform. The Hollow teaches her that dissonance is not always error — sometimes it is a different kind of music.

relationshipHooks: Cross-faction envoys can challenge their doctrine without erasing their faction identity.
developmentStatus: Readable profile integrated into dashboard character pages.
mythological_sources: Sophia (Pistis Sophia, Wisdom of Solomon, Gnostic texts)
human_echo: Sophia's wisdom was the truth behind Gnostic seeking; 'more beautiful than the sun' (Wisdom 7:29)
